question: Approximate values of the integral $I(x)=\displaystyle\int_0^x(\cos t)e^{-t^2/10}dt$ are given in the following table: $x:\ \pi/2,\pi,3\pi/2,2\pi$ and $I(x):\ 0.95,0.44,0.18,0.22$. Which of the following numbers best approximates the value of the integral $\displaystyle\int_0^{5\pi/4}(\cos t)e^{-t^2/10}dt$?
